text: GBP/USD pushed down through the killzone, gave up its Asia low and sits about 13 pips under the leg's midpoint. EUR/USD only tagged its Asia low, bounced and is back on its midpoint, so the two pairs disagree on the sell-side (SMT). Unspent: the GBP/USD previous day low below and the EUR/USD previous week low above; times unverified today.
